purpose: Machine-readable description of retained T2-T7 inference components and native task semantics. This manifest does not create a universal prediction space.

T2.name: Priority
T2.input_boundary: Creation-time ticket text fields permitted by T2 contract
T2.probability_semantics: Native classifier probabilities only; not a universal confidence measure
T2.calibration_status: Not established as a universal operational confidence layer
known_limitations: Chronological validation-to-test degradation is documented.
P4 and P5 performance is substantially weaker than majority classes.
No autonomous priority assignment is supported.

T3.name: Severity
T3.input_boundary: Creation-time ticket text fields permitted by T3 contract
T3.probability_semantics: Native classifier output only; not a universal confidence measure
known_limitations: Locked-test macro F1 is substantially lower than weighted F1.
S1 has very small locked-test support.
DistilBERT feasibility branch was closed and is not the retained model.

T4.name: Historical Routing / Assignment Retrieval
T4.input_boundary: Ticket fields permitted by T4 historical retrieval contract
T4.output_semantics: Historically observed assignee candidates ranked by retrieval evidence
known_limitations: Historical retrieval is not operational eligibility.
Historical retrieval is not proof of current routing correctness.
Open-world unseen targets cannot be retrieved.
Coverage and Hit@20 limitations remain documented.

T5.name: Duplicate Detection
T5.input_boundary: Creator, Creator Detail, Summary and Description within the documented Creation-time boundary
T5.output_semantics: p_duplicate for existence of an observed post-Creation 'Dupe of' relationship
T5.probability_semantics: Native calibrated duplicate probability under the retained task definition; not a universal confidence score
known_limitations: The target establishes relationship existence, not target-ticket identification.
Provenance limitation is retained.
The descriptive 0.5 threshold is not an operational threshold.
Human review removal is not supported.

T6.name: Similar / Duplicate-Related Ticket Retrieval
T6.final_model: T6-MOD-010 corrected hybrid lexical + semantic retrieval
T6.input_boundary: Query and frozen candidate pool defined by T6 contract
T6.output_semantics: Ranked similar/duplicate-related ticket candidates using corrected hybrid lexical + semantic retrieval
known_limitations: Observable non-positive candidates are not true negatives.
Candidate pool and ranking semantics are frozen.
No probability interpretation is permitted.
No universal automation threshold is established.

T7.name: Resolution-Time Survival
T7.input_boundary: Creation-time features permitted by T7 temporal contract
T7.probability_semantics: Survival quantities are native survival-model outputs and are not cross-task confidence scores
T7.calibration_status: No formal IPCW survival calibration suitable for autonomous production use was established
known_limitations: Unresolved observations are right-censored, not negative duration targets.
Log-Normal AFT did not uniformly dominate reference survival baselines.
No validated automation threshold exists.
Current artifact is specification-based rather than a serialized estimator.
